source: Türkeli: Mekân Nüfus Tarih (2016), Pelin İskender Kılıç, Mucize Ünlü ve Nedim İpek, Ayandon Kazasının 1841 Yılı Nüfus Defteri, BOA NFS.d.847
scope: 13 historic divans, 92 Muslim locality records, 6 mixed-community Rum census records
household_discrepancy: Book's high-level Muslim hane total is 805; village-by-village final Hane serial values total 807. Do not force reconcile, preserve source references. Book's rum household totals are represented as 86 in narrative and numbered village lines; source summary tables may differ.
place_corrections: Current Türkeli centre is Yarna historically (book ch.5 p302), not Ayandon itself.
NFS.d.847 Ayandon locality and historic Ayandon kaza separate from modern Türkeli centre.
Modern villages from ch.5 crosswalk only; no unsupported map coordinates.
male_data_cautions: Oğrı printed last serial 93 but text shows 9 persons.
Fariye Aydükler 15 and Kalaycıköy 27 use age-distribution analysis to avoid misleading serial maxima.
All male totals are source-listed male persons, not assumed total male+female population.
genealogy_limit: Surnames are assigned to their historical village from published Elkab/Lakap tables. Person-by-person full surname-to-household genealogy not yet completed; household numbers were not invented.
separate_source_issue: Book's Ayaz Kayabaşı Oğnaz excerpts are from İstefan BOA NFS.d.914 and excluded from NFS.d.847; earlier archive_library_verified Ayaz 847 record should be checked against Ottoman original.
